headline: The right service for where you are right now.
subheading: Whether you need to nail your target market, get found on Google, write words that convert, or build a complete digital strategy — there's a service built for that.

items.title: Target market strategy
items.description: Most small businesses market to everyone. That means they reach no one. I help you get precise about who your customer actually is — then build everything else around that clarity.

items.title: SEO
items.description: If your customers are searching for what you do and you're not showing up, you're invisible. I make sure the right people find you at the right moment — without paying for every click.

items.title: Copywriting
items.description: Most business copy is forgettable. Yours doesn't have to be. I write words that speak directly to your customer in language they recognise — and move them to act.

items.title: Digital strategy
items.description: If you want the full picture — where you are, where you need to go, and exactly how to get there — this is it. A complete digital strategy built around your business, not a template.

cta.headline: Not sure which service is right for you?
cta.subheading: Book a free call and we'll figure it out together. No pitch, no pressure.
